js.home: const cate = env.get("category", "");const page = Number(env.get("page", 1) || 1);const p = page || 1;const base = env.baseUrl;const listUrl = p <= 1 ? (base + "/tv/" + cate + ".html") : (base + "/tv/" + cate + "/page/" + p + ".html");const html = await req(listUrl);const $ = kitty.load(html);const items = [];$("a.thumb").each(function () {const $a = $(this);const href = $a.attr("href") || "";const m = href.match(/\/video\/(\d+)\.html/);if (m && items.length < 40) {const id = m[1];const title = $a.attr("title") || "";const img = $a.find("img").first();const cover = img.attr("data-original") || img.attr("data-src") || img.attr("src") || "";const key = "/video/" + id + "/";if (title && !items.some(x => x.id === key)) {let remark = $a.find(".hot").first().text().trim() || $a.find("span").first().text().trim() || "";items.push({ id: key, title, cover, remark });}}});if (!cate) {return { type: "complex", data: [{ type: "card", title: "AI漫剧", videos: items }] };}return items;
js.detail: let id = env.get("movieId", "");if (!id) return { id: "", title: "", cover: "", playlist: [] };const m = String(id).match(/(\d+)/);if (m) id = m[1];const html = await req(env.baseUrl + "/video/" + id + ".html");const $ = kitty.load(html);let title = $("h1").text().trim();if (!title) title = ($("meta[property=og:title]").attr("content") || "").replace(/^《/, "").replace(/》.*$/, "");let cover = "";$("img").each(function () {const src = $(this).attr("data-original") || $(this).attr("data-src") || $(this).attr("src") || "";if (!cover && /(upload|uploads|vod)/.test(src) && !/load/.test(src)) cover = src;});let desc = $("meta[name=description]").attr("content") || "";desc = desc.replace(/\s+/g, " ").slice(0, 300);const eps = [];$("a").each(function () {const $a = $(this);const href = $a.attr("href") || "";const em = href.match(/^\/play\/(\d+)\/(\d+)\/(\d+)\.html$/);if (em && em[1] === String(id)) {const text = $a.text().trim();if (text && text.length < 20) eps.push({ text, id: env.baseUrl + "/play/" + em[1] + "/" + em[2] + "/" + em[3] + ".html" });}});const unique = [];eps.forEach(e => { if (!unique.some(x => x.id === e.id)) unique.push(e); });return { id: "/video/" + id + "/", title, cover, desc, remark: "AI漫剧", playlist: [{ title: "播放线路", videos: unique }] };
js.search: const wd = env.get("keyword", "");if (!wd) return [];const html = await req(env.baseUrl + "/search/" + encodeURIComponent(wd) + ".html");const $ = kitty.load(html);const items = [];$("a.thumb").each(function () {const $a = $(this);const href = $a.attr("href") || "";const m = href.match(/\/video\/(\d+)\.html/);if (m && items.length < 20) {const id = m[1];const title = $a.attr("title") || "";const img = $a.find("img").first();const cover = img.attr("data-original") || img.attr("src") || "";const key = "/video/" + id + "/";if (title && !items.some(x => x.id === key)) items.push({ id: key, title, cover, remark: "" });}});return items;
js.parseIframe: const iframe = env.get("iframe", "");if (!iframe) return "";const html = await req(iframe);const m = html.match(/player_aaaa\s*=\s*(\{[\s\S]*?\})\s*;?\s*<\/script>/);if (m) {try {const cfg = JSON.parse(m[1]);if (cfg.url) return String(cfg.url).replace(/\\\//g, "/");} catch (e) {}}const m2 = html.match(/"url"\s*:\s*"([^"]+\.m3u8[^"]*)"/);if (m2) return m2[1].replace(/\\\//g, "/");return "";
